prompt.zh-TW: 下列哪些情況會讓一家公司「這一期有賺錢，現金卻變少」？
prompt.en: Which of the following would leave a company profitable this period yet with less cash than before?

text.zh-TW: 這一期賒銷很多，貨款大多還沒收回
text.en: Many sales this period were on credit and most of the money has not yet been collected

short.en: Heavy credit sales not yet collected

feedback.zh-TW: 會。收入算進利益，現金卻沒進來；如果這一期的進貨與開銷都用現金付了，帳上現金就可能不增反減。
feedback.en: Yes. The revenue is in profit, but the cash has not come in; if this period’s purchases and expenses were paid in cash, the cash balance can end up lower rather than higher.

text.zh-TW: 用現金買了一大批存貨，還沒賣出去
text.en: A large batch of inventory was bought for cash and has not yet been sold

feedback.zh-TW: 會。付出去的錢變成倉庫裡的存貨，沒賣出去之前不影響利益，現金卻已經少了。
feedback.en: Yes. The cash paid has turned into stock on the shelves; until it is sold, profit is untouched while cash is already lower.

text.en: A loan was taken out from the bank

feedback.zh-TW: 借款確實和利益無關，這點沒錯。不過它會讓現金變多，不是變少，所以不是「有賺錢現金卻變少」的原因。
feedback.en: A loan is indeed unrelated to profit, that much is right. But it makes cash go up, not down, so it is not a reason for cash falling while profit is earned.

text.zh-TW: 這一期提列了很高的折舊費用
text.en: A large depreciation charge was recorded this period

feedback.zh-TW: 折舊確實會讓利益變少，這點沒錯。不過它沒有任何現金流出；現金早在買設備那一年就付掉了。折舊會讓「利益比現金低」，不會讓現金變少。
feedback.en: Depreciation does lower profit, that much is right. But no cash flows out with it; the cash left in the year the equipment was bought. Depreciation makes profit lower than cash, not cash lower.

explanation.zh-TW: 「有賺錢、現金卻變少」通常是錢換成了別的東西、還沒回到戶頭：{{option:o_aatp}}時，錢還在客人那裡，是{{term:tm_r7x2c9fa}}；{{option:o_7290}}時，錢變成倉庫裡的{{term:tm_n7v3k8pq}}。{{option:o_cmnh}}讓現金變多，{{option:o_zdmh}}只影響利益、不影響現金。
explanation.en: Profitable but cash-poor usually means the money has turned into something else and has not come back to the bank yet: with {{option:o_aatp}}, it is still with customers as {{term:tm_r7x2c9fa}}; with {{option:o_7290}}, it has become {{term:tm_n7v3k8pq}} in the storeroom. {{option:o_cmnh}} raises cash, and {{option:o_zdmh}} affects only profit, not cash.
